candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits only a source-distinguished counter-assumption analysis carrying no policy or settlement authority. The final call consumes that analysis while independently receiving every common input, treats the analysis as defeasible evidence, reconciles both views under undivided authority, and emits one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Defeasible Dual-View Reacquisition
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with one nonbinding analysis handoff and terminal lossless evidence reacquisition

calls.objective: Identify conflicts between inherited topology assumptions and the supplied evidence, preserve source distinctions and unresolved tensions, and emit a nonbinding analysis without creating or authorizing a policy artifact.

Consume map_counter_assumptions together with every common input, treat the analysis as defeasible rather than binding, resolve disagreements through direct evidence comparison, and emit one complete policy under undivided authority.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: contract-locked executable handoff with downstream behavior-only revision
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: A defeasible counter-analysis and all original evidence must remain simultaneously visible to one terminal authority with no inherited policy settlement.
rejected_assumptions: A preterminal executable artifact is necessary for useful structural continuity.
Contract authority and behavior authority should be partitioned across successive calls.
A downstream policy authority should inherit a binding upstream settlement.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the binding executable handoff with one defeasible dual-view handoff: the terminal authority receives a nonbinding counter-assumption analysis alongside a lossless reacquisition of every common input.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Joint reconsideration without inherited settlement authority should improve phase-shift adaptation and scan resistance by allowing contract interpretation and behavioral intent to change together.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The active family prematurely converts shared evidence into a binding executable settlement, forcing downstream reasoning to remain inside inherited contract-versus-behavior authority partitions.

structural_mutation.after: A nonbinding counter-assumption analysis crosses the edge while the terminal call independently reacquires all common evidence and holds undivided authority to emit the sole policy.
structural_mutation.before: A complete executable closure crosses a binding edge with contract conformance locked and only behavior-semantic authority delegated downstream.
structural_mutation.factor: defeasible dual-view handoff with lossless terminal evidence reacquisition
structural_mutation.why_structural: The single handoff protocol changes edge authority from binding to defeasible and terminal visibility from inherited settlement plus partial evidence to analysis-plus-lossless evidence. Unlike a sealed-analysis edge, it preserves direct terminal comparison against every original input.

validation.factor: defeasible dual-view handoff with lossless terminal evidence reacquisition
